related.title: 非交換操作的驗證：從 Bloch 旋轉到編織主張
related.titleEn: Noncommuting operations: from Bloch rotations to braiding claims
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：正下界只支持此模型下存在非零能隙；仍須獨立端點、非局域與替代機制檢驗。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A positive bound supports a nonzero gap within this model only; endpoint, nonlocal and alternative-mechanism tests remain necessary. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 建立能辨別操作次序的量測，避免測到相同Z人口就宣稱兩操作可交換。
related.differenceEn: Construct an order-sensitive measurement instead of inferring commutation from equalZ populations.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。合成能隙估值50μeV、1σ不確定度10μeV，尚未加入共同校準偏差。 Δ低=50−2×10。 代入 50-2*10，得到 30 micro-eV。本課以Δ低=Δ估−2σ作近似雙側95%區間下端；需高斯近似和已知標準差，非拓樸判定器。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。α=β=π/2，理想無雜訊；讀出基底為X。 P(+X)=(1+sin(π/2)cos(π/2))/2。 代入 (1+sin(pi/2)*cos(pi/2))/2，得到 0.5 probability。初態+Z先Rx(α)再Ry(β)，最後X分量=sinβcosα，故P(+X)=(1+sinβcosα)/2；抽象旋轉不證明物理編織。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Synthetic gap estimate50μeV with1σ uncertainty10μeV, before common calibration bias. Δlow=50−2×10. Substituting 50-2*10 gives 30 micro-eV. UseΔlow=Δestimate−2σ as an approximate lower endpoint of a95% two-sided interval under Gaussian assumptions, not as a topology classifier. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. α=β=π/2 in a noiseless model withX-basis readout. P(+X)=(1+sin(π/2)cos(π/2))/2. Substituting (1+sin(pi/2)*cos(pi/2))/2 gives 0.5 probability. Starting+Z, applyRx(α) thenRy(β): finalX=sinβcosα, soP(+X)=(1+sinβcosα)/2; abstract rotations do not prove physical braiding. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
